meaning: Published ripple texture screened as candidate sand, with declared buffered exclusions. Not a validated sand-trap detector or soil failure probability.
inputs: HiRISE DEM and optical; NOAH-H texture; THEMIS thermal context. No unregistered rover imagery transferred to orbital cells.
limitations: Unknown texture remains traversable under DEM constraints and is reported separately.
Independent local registration residual, soil bearing strength and observation dates are unknown.
Five-metre buffer is a planning assumption, not a measured positional error bound.
Thermal inertia is not used to make fine-grained hard trap exclusions.

source.title: NOAH-H terrain classifications of Jezero Crater, Mars
source.credit: Wright, Barrett, Fawdon, Favaro, Balme, Woods, Karachalios & Gerdes; The Open University / ESA NOAH

registration.status: Original source rasters were georeferenced by the authors; supplied tie points do not establish a measured residual against this project's later Caltech orthomosaic/DEM. No independent local registration residual measured.

draft.purpose: Inspect surface texture and compare local terrain.
